intended_object: An internal step in the canonical-tree proof of the Erdős–Rado theorem (EHMR §14). The successor set S(h) of a tree node h is the set of points y that lie above every representative rep x and whose pair-color with rep x equals the recorded color col x. This is inferred from the docstring and the "EHMR canonical-tree skeleton" section comment.
explanation: This set is a technical device inside the library's proof of the Erdős–Rado partition theorem. It is not a standard mathematical notion with its own definition in the literature. It is the set S(h) used in the Erdős–Hajnal–Máté–Rado tree construction, and it feeds `ehmrChosen`, which picks the least element of S(h) by well-founded recursion. The body does match its stated role: it is the set of y with rep x < y and cR(pair(rep x, y)) = col x for every position x below β. Still, the object exists only as proof scaffolding, specialised to `Source κ` and to pair colorings, and Mathlib has nothing comparable. For these reasons it counts as an auxiliary construction rather than a mathematical object.
